notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nonland permanent.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another nonland permanent, adding {C}{C}.
Because the permanent is a Clue artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Senator Peacock, Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token that is also a Clue artifact.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Human Soldiers to their own abilities to draw infinite cards.
